summary: Every policy change and revoke is fully audited, and initial passwords are never shown or saved.

fixes.title: Policy changes audited rule by rule
fixes.text: The audit trail records each policy rule's value before and after, its template, and whether an approved mass-change plan applied it.

fixes.title: Revokes and passes audited as they happen
fixes.text: Revokes, Temporary Access Pass resets and session revokes record who asked, what was done to whom, how it was verified and the outcome.

fixes.title: Initial passwords never shown or saved
fixes.text: Creating an admin from the setup tools never shows or keeps a password. Onboard the admin with a Temporary Access Pass.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: A refused commit stays on Pending changes with its blocking errors and fixes, and template rows with a placeholder subscription are not offered for import.
